supporter.win.body: We beat {opponent}. That's my weekend sorted.
Our guys got the win. I can enjoy the rest of the scores now.
{nickname} win. I'm allowing myself a little optimism.
We won. The group chat is a much nicer place tonight.
Happy with the result. Still want more from us, but I'll take the W.
{opponent} in the win column for us. Not every post needs a complaint.
Our {nickname} got it done. Let me be happy about that for a minute.
A win and a little breathing room. Good day to be one of us.

supporter.relief.body: We beat {opponent}. You can unclench now.
Our {nickname} won. My ability to be normal about a close game remains questionable.
Not much between us and {opponent} on the scoreboard. I'll take being on this side of it.
A close win is still OUR win. Deep breaths.
We got the result. I'm celebrating first and worrying about the margin tomorrow.
We beat {opponent}, {score}. Relief counts as celebration.
Our side of a close score is the winning side. That will do for tonight.
We edged {opponent}. My confidence is still catching up with my relief.

supporter.upset.body: WE beat {opponent}. Yes, I'm going to keep saying it.
Our {nickname}. Against {opponent}. And WE won. Give me a minute.
I'm trying to act like I expected us to beat {opponent}. I did not prepare for this.
We beat {opponent} and suddenly I'm available for every football conversation.
Our guys pulled that off. The rankings can wait; I'm enjoying this.
{opponent} can keep the ranking. We'll keep the win.
All the sensible predictions, and then our {nickname} went and won it.
We got {opponent}. Cautious optimism has temporarily left the building.

supporter.rivalry.body: We beat {opponent}. For purely educational reasons, I will be reminding people.
Our {nickname} won this one. Rivalry conversations are going to be very pleasant for me.
{opponent} fans and I have a lot to discuss. Mostly the part where we won.
We won. I'm sure I'll be perfectly reasonable about this rivalry result.
The bragging rights are ours. I'm going to use them.
{nickname} over {opponent}. A lovely result to keep bringing up.
Our side gets the win AND the argument. Productive day.
We beat the rival. Suddenly every rival group chat looks inviting.

supporter.loss.body: We lost to {opponent}. I don't need a neutral voice telling me how to feel about it.
Our {nickname} lost. I can support them and still be frustrated.
{opponent} got us. Annoying to type, but that's the result.
I had a much better post planned for us. Unfortunately, {opponent} won.
Another day of caring far too much about our football team.
We lost. The {nickname} optimism department is taking a short break.
Credit to {opponent}. That's all the generosity I have in me right now.
Our guys couldn't get the win. Still our team; still hurts.

supporter.heavy-loss.body: We lost to {opponent} by a lot. I am not volunteering to discuss the margin.
Our {nickname} took a heavy loss. No clever explanation from me tonight.
{opponent} beat us comfortably. I wish I had a less accurate sentence.
We were on the wrong end of that score. Supporting this team remains a full-time emotional hobby.
Our optimism and that final score are having a difficult conversation.
I'm still a {nickname} fan. I'd just appreciate a smaller test of that commitment.
{opponent} got the big win. Our group chat has entered the staring-at-the-wall phase.
A heavy loss for us. I can be loyal without pretending that feels fine.
